_comment: Game Rules (launcher page). The launcher writes the player's picks to data\rules.txt as key=value lines; start.ps1 reads this file for the defaults and passes each rule to the metagame as its env variable (rules162.ts).

rules.title: Weapon XP speed
rules.blurb: How fast weapons level up and the Slayer's Path fills. The end-of-hunt screen still shows the normal numbers; your totals get the multiplied amount.

rules.title: Hunt Pass XP speed
rules.blurb: How fast Hunt Pass levels come. Works for every season on the Seasons page.

rules.title: Loot amount
rules.blurb: More materials, Rams and Cell Cores from every hunt.

rules.title: Free crafting
rules.blurb: Crafting and upgrading gear keep your materials and Rams. You still need them once to start the craft.

rules.title: Unlimited Resupply Beacons
rules.blurb: Resupply beacons keep their charge, so you can stay in the Hunting Grounds as long as you like. Solo play only: games you host for others always have normal beacons. The beacon counter may still show 1/1.

rules.title: Universal progress rate
rules.blurb: Multiplies weapon XP, Hunt Pass XP and mastery progress at once, on top of their own rules below.

rules.title: Mastery progress
rules.blurb: Extra mastery points each time a mastery box completes. Points you earn are kept if you change this later.

rules.title: Ram reward amount
rules.blurb: More Rams from every hunt, on top of Loot amount. Shop prices and spending stay normal.

rules.title: Combat Merit amount
rules.blurb: More Combat Merits from hunts. Spending stays normal.

rules.title: Exploration Merit amount
rules.blurb: More Airship (Exploration) Merits from hunts. Spending stays normal.

rules.title: Rare Cell Core amount
rules.blurb: More Rare Cell Cores from hunts, including the ones from the rule below.

rules.title: Rare Cell Core on behemoth kill
rules.blurb: Every behemoth kill also gives a Rare Cell Core.

rules.title: Trial boss
rules.blurb: Pick the behemoth you fight in Trials (Hard and Elite). This week's boss = the normal rotation. When you host, your pick is used for everyone in your game; games open to everyone use this week's boss.

rules.title: Extra loadout slots
rules.blurb: Free loadout slots on top of the normal 10. Kept while you host.

rules.title: When you host
rules.blurb: Host with friends or LAN: Use my rules = your Game Rules on this page apply to everyone in your game, and the players who join you take home what they earn with them. Standard rules = everyone plays with normal rules while you host. Games open to everyone (Allow randoms, Play online) always use the standard rules.
